Hi all — I’m looking for someone comfortable with category theory for a short paid writing pilot.

  • Task: given a Lean theorem, write a clear English statement of the same mathematical claim. I can share a short instruction note and a few examples over DM.
  • Time: a few hours, async, your schedule.
  • Pay / credit: paid; we can agree a fair rate if it’s a fit.
  • Low commitment: DM me and I’ll send a one-page note and 3–5 examples. No need to decide on the full pilot from this post.

Happy to discuss rate and timeline privately.
Thanks,
Mohsen
May I ask: if this for training some AI system? Just worth being transparent about this, not making a judgement either way.
Yes — it’s for AI research. Thanks for asking me to say that clearly.
cf #meta: off-topic > working to help AI do math @ 💬
